data.title: 佩丽卡 · 雪原观测站读数
data.description: 【佩丽卡 · 雪原观测站读数】清晨的雪原观测站外，佩丽卡穿着厚实的白蓝拼色防寒派克服，保暖长裤和手套挡住冷风。她站在固定的传感器旁，一手稳住读数板，另一手按下确认键，回头示意记录完成——「读数已经稳定。我们进站核对下一组数据。」
data.action: 站在传感器旁，一手托读数板，另一手按下确认键
data.promptProse: Outside a frostfield monitoring station, Perlica wears her insulated white-and-blue parka, thermal trousers and gloves, holding a readout tablet steady while pressing its confirmation key beside a fixed sensor mast. Pale dawn light spreads across the snow and frosted metal housing, while an amber doorway lamp marks the sheltered entrance behind her.
data.camera: medium shot, sensor housing and tablet visible beside the station entrance
data.lighting: 雪原清晨冷光与入口暖灯
